scope: Reusable skill, PC project workflows, shared Lua host behavior and native development-slot build; device acceptance recorded separately.

host_validation.negative_fixture_expectation: reject before test execution or candidate publication; retain previous candidate
host_validation.windows_link_tests: two symlink creation tests skipped because the host does not permit creating their fixtures; Linux CI runs them

retained_linux_ci_failure.cause: Container uid 0 with all capabilities dropped could not write a Linux host-uid-owned mode-755 output bind.
retained_linux_ci_failure.fix: Use invoking host UID:GID on POSIX; preserve Windows defaults.
retained_linux_ci_failure.real_linux_permissions_reproduction: Old compile failed with Permission denied; fixed compile and actual 120-frame shared Lua starter run passed.

plan_only_music_player.finding: Native audio/media provisioning needs adapter work; current Lua sandbox cannot provide a local music player.

native_prototype.hardware_lifecycle: two bounded cycles across two app builds passed through registered MCP tools
native_prototype.source_iteration: Initial horizontal ball speed changed from 220 to 300 pixels/second. The old 50 ms position oracle correctly failed; the intended new x=495 expectation then passed before version 01.03 redeployment.
native_prototype.preflight: Initial unavailability preceded all writes; operator confirmed the Vita had slept. After a physical wake and fresh ready guard, each new effect plan executed once.

boundaries: One VMCP00001 native development bubble; arbitrary titles and accepted app replacement are unsupported.
Lua requires an already-open healthy paused DevLoop 01.04; the script-only path does not launch or keep it awake.
Native callbacks have no Lua instruction or memory containment and must return promptly.
Embedded assets and the fixed linked libraries only; media, audio and additional dependencies need reviewed adapter work.
Unknown native effects are retained and reconciled read-only without replay.
True sleep or lost Wi-Fi can require a physical wake; boot/sleep settings are preserved.
iPhone implementation, signing/build artifacts, credentials, private projects and raw device evidence remain private.
next_qualification_slice: A bounded Resident work lease to prevent idle sleep during active development, with explicit expiry/release and crash/disconnect recovery; preserve ordinary sleep settings and qualify independently.
